---
applyTo: "app/**/*.{ts,tsx},components/**/*.{ts,tsx},hooks/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
---

# Frontend Instructions

- Expo/React Native/Web compatible by default.
- Expo Router for navigation.
- NativeWind for styling.
- build RTL Hebrew and LTR English intentionally.
- keep Supabase/network work out of presentational components.
- use TanStack Query for server state.
- do not persist sensitive auth/provider secrets in plain storage.
- add accessible labels and reasonable touch targets.
